items.summary: PTI's verified multimedia account published footage of CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke arriving in Delhi (airport terminal), fulfilling his Oct-13 pledge from Hingoli to reach the capital on Wednesday. Surrounded by reporters (NDTV, PTI mics) and uniformed police, he gives his first on-camera statement since the SEM Mandir Marg order: Ashu and Saurav were sent to five days' jail for unfurling the tricolour at Jantar Mantar — "Is waving the tricolour wrong? This is a sign of dictatorship." Single-sourced to the PTI reel as of this run (no web-news outlet carrying the arrival yet); the watch had Dipke in Hingoli as its top watch item.
items.title: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke arrives in Delhi from Hingoli; first on-camera statement since 5-day JC order
